title: lidia obtusiloba
intro: Lidia obtusiloba, commonly known as the toothache tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Annonaceae. It is traditionally used to alleviate dental pain and has been found to exhibit various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lidia obtusiloba include analgesic and antiseptic effects, which can help in treating toothaches and other oral health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include annonaceous acetogenins, which have been shown to possess potential anticancer and neuroprotective properties.
